content:
I am delighted to share that I have been granted my Certificate of Practice, marking an important milestone in my legal journey.

This achievement reflects years of hard work, dedication and learning. I look forward to building on this foundation, expanding my legal knowledge and contributing meaningfully to the legal profession.

I am grateful to my family, mentors, teachers and everyone who has supported and encouraged me throughout this journey. Here’s to continuous learning and new beginnings!
comment: A Certificate of Practice is also the start of learning how law works beyond textbooks. Developing judgment, client communication and ethical decision-making often becomes the real foundation of a legal career.
